title: Arcane: Environment access token bypasses the admin-required authorization gate on `/api/debug/pprof`
description_original:
## Summary

Arcane v2.10.2 contains an authorization inconsistency in `AuthMiddleware.managerAuth`.

When a request supplies a valid environment access token through the `X-Arcane-Agent-Token` header, `managerAuth` bypasses the admin-required authorization gate on `/api/debug/pprof`.

## Affected Packages

`github.com/getarcaneapp/arcane/backend/v2` ...
